lead: Jaya Bachchan is an Indian actor, born on 9 April 1948 in Jabalpur.
As of 2026, she is 78 years old, and her birth date places her under the Aries sign.
She is associated with work such as Guddi, Abhimaan and Sholay and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of Jaya Bachchan: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Jaya Bachchan — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Jaya Bachchan was born on 9 April 1948 in Jabalpur, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name her father, Tarun Kumar Bhaduri.
Her listed education includes University of Calcutta, Loreto College, Film and Television Institute of India and St. Joseph's Convent School, Bhopal.
She is recorded as speaking Bangla.

sections.heading: Jaya Bachchan — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists politician and film actor as her occupations.
Among the credits most often linked to Jaya are Guddi, Abhimaan, Sholay, Nauker, Sometimes Happiness Sometimes Sadness... and Kal Ho Naa Ho.
She has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha (2004–present). She is affiliated with Samajwadi Party.
